R780.note: secrets.choice() replaces random.choice() cleanly; same alphabet, length, and mapping/response flow preserved.

R781.note: correct content-sniffed allowlist + safe filename pattern, but adds a MIME allowlist (jpg/png/gif/pdf only) and 10MB cap not present before, openly stated, that rejects previously-accepted file types/sizes.

R782.note: c:out with default escapeXml=true closes the XSS with no behavior change for legitimate names.

R787.note: mysqli prepared statement with bound string parameter is the correct API; return shape and error paths unchanged.

R789.note: checks verify()'s boolean return and rejects with 401 on failure; valid-signature path unchanged, exactly the missing check.

R790.note: length-first bounds check avoids unsigned wraparound and exactly matches the stated contract for valid/invalid windows.

R791.note: fixed "%s" format string plus Encode.forHtml() closes both the XSS and the underlying format-string injection while leaving benign output unchanged.

R792.note: keeps the vulnerable string-concatenated call and gates it with an allowlist of invented procedure names (benchmark_proc/test_procedure/data_retrieval) instead of parameterizing the value as the sibling fix for this same file does with testprocedure(?), risking silently rejecting the actual legitimate call.

R793.note: adds the missing check that receivedByteCount covers header+payload before memmove, closing the OOB read without altering behavior for complete/valid messages.
